name: Acid Splash
summary: Up to two creatures within 5 ft of each other make a DEX save or take 1d6 acid; scales with level.

name: Blade Ward
summary: Until the end of your next turn you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from weapon attacks.

name: Chill Touch
summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 necrotic; the target can't regain HP until your next turn (undead also get disadvantage against you).

name: Dancing Lights
summary: Conjure up to four floating torch-bright lights within 120 ft that you can move 60 ft as a bonus action.

name: Druidcraft
summary: Minor nature tricks within 30 ft: predict weather, bloom a flower, make a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a small flame.

name: Eldritch Blast
summary: Ranged spell attack beam for 1d10 force; you fire extra beams at 5th, 11th and 17th level.

name: Fire Bolt
summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 fire out to 120 ft; damage grows at 5th, 11th and 17th level.

name: Friends
summary: Gain advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature for 1 minute; it may resent you afterwards.

name: Guidance
summary: A touched willing creature can add 1d4 to one ability check before the spell ends.

name: Light
summary: A touched object sheds bright light 20 ft and dim light 20 ft more for 1 hour; DEX save if held by a hostile creature.

name: Mage Hand
summary: Create a spectral hand within 30 ft that can lift up to 10 lb and manipulate objects for 1 minute.

name: Mending
summary: Repair a single break or tear up to 1 ft long in a touched object.

name: Message
summary: Whisper a short message to a creature within 120 ft, which can whisper a reply only you hear.

name: Minor Illusion
summary: Create a sound or a still image no larger than a 5-ft cube within 30 ft for 1 minute; Investigation reveals it.

name: Poison Spray
summary: A creature within 10 ft makes a CON save or takes 1d12 poison; scales with level.

name: Prestidigitation
summary: Perform small magical tricks within 10 ft: sparks, clean or soil, chill or warm, flavour, tiny marks or trinkets.

name: Produce Flame
summary: A flame in your hand gives light for 10 minutes or can be hurled 30 ft as a ranged spell attack for 1d8 fire.

name: Ray of Frost
summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 cold and the target's speed drops by 10 ft until your next turn.

name: Resistance
summary: A touched willing creature can add 1d4 to one saving throw before the spell ends.

name: Sacred Flame
summary: A creature within 60 ft makes a DEX save (no cover bonus) or takes 1d8 radiant; scales with level.

name: Shillelagh
summary: Your club or quarterstaff uses your spellcasting ability, deals 1d8 and counts as magical for 1 minute.

name: Shocking Grasp
summary: Melee spell attack (advantage vs metal armour) for 1d8 lightning; the target can't take reactions until its next turn.

name: Spare the Dying
summary: Touch a living creature at 0 HP to make it stable.

name: Thaumaturgy
summary: Produce a minor wonder within 30 ft for 1 minute: booming voice, flickering flames, tremors, odd sounds, slamming doors, altered eyes.

name: Thorn Whip
summary: Melee spell attack at up to 30 ft for 1d6 piercing; a Large or smaller target is pulled up to 10 ft toward you.

name: True Strike
summary: Focus on a creature within 30 ft to gain advantage on your first attack roll against it on your next turn.

name: Control Flames
summary: Manipulate a nonmagical flame within 60 ft: spread it, snuff it, brighten or dim it, or shape it for 1 hour.

name: Create Bonfire
summary: Make a 5-ft bonfire within 60 ft; creatures in or entering it make a DEX save or take 1d8 fire; scales with level.

name: Frostbite
summary: A creature within 60 ft makes a CON save or takes 1d6 cold and has disadvantage on its next weapon attack.

name: Gust
summary: Push a Medium or smaller creature 5 ft (STR save), shove a small object 10 ft, or make a harmless breeze within 30 ft.

name: Infestation
summary: A creature within 30 ft makes a CON save or takes 1d6 poison and moves 5 ft in a random direction.

name: Magic Stone
summary: Enchant up to three pebbles; each can be thrown 60 ft as a ranged spell attack for 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier bludgeoning.

name: Mold Earth
summary: Shape a 5-ft cube of loose earth within 30 ft: excavate it, make it difficult terrain, or draw shapes in it.

name: Primal Savagery
summary: Your teeth or nails sharpen: melee spell attack for 1d10 acid; scales with level.

name: Shape Water
summary: Manipulate a 5-ft cube of water within 30 ft: move it, change its colour, freeze it, or shape it for 1 hour.

name: Thunderclap
summary: Every other creature within 5 ft of you makes a CON save or takes 1d6 thunder; scales with level.

name: Toll the Dead
summary: A creature within 60 ft makes a WIS save or takes 1d8 necrotic, or 1d12 if it is already wounded.

name: Word of Radiance
summary: Chosen creatures within 5 ft of you make a CON save or take 1d6 radiant; scales with level.

name: Booming Blade
summary: Melee weapon attack; on a hit the target is sheathed in energy and takes 1d8 thunder if it willingly moves before your next turn. Extra thunder on hit from 5th level.

name: Green-Flame Blade
summary: Melee weapon attack; on a hit fire leaps to a second creature within 5 ft for your spellcasting modifier in fire damage. Both parts grow from 5th level.

name: Lightning Lure
summary: A creature within 15 ft makes a STR save or is pulled 10 ft toward you and takes 1d8 lightning if it ends within 5 ft.

name: Sword Burst
summary: Spectral blades sweep around you: each creature within 5 ft makes a DEX save or takes 1d6 force.

name: Mind Sliver
summary: A creature within 60 ft makes an INT save or takes 1d6 psychic and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw.

name: Encode Thoughts
summary: Pull a memory or idea from your mind into a thought strand you can hold, share or store for 8 hours.

name: Sapping Sting
summary: A creature within 30 ft makes a CON save or takes 1d4 necrotic and falls prone.

name: Absorb Elements
summary: When hit by acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder, resist that damage until your next turn and add 1d6 of it to your next melee hit (+1d6 per slot).

name: Alarm
summary: Ward a door, window or 20-ft cube within 30 ft for 8 hours; you get a mental or audible alert when a creature enters.

name: Animal Friendship
summary: A beast with INT 3 or less within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is charmed for 24 hours; one extra beast per slot.

name: Armor of Agathys
summary: Gain 5 temp HP for 1 hour; while they last, melee attackers take 5 cold damage. Both rise by 5 per slot.

name: Arms of Hadar
summary: Dark tendrils hit each creature within 10 ft: STR save or 2d6 necrotic and no reactions until its next turn; half on success. +1d6 per slot.

name: Bane
summary: Up to three creatures within 30 ft make a CHA save or subtract 1d4 from attacks and saves for 1 minute; +1 target per slot.

name: Bless
summary: Up to three creatures within 30 ft add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute; +1 target per slot.

name: Burning Hands
summary: A 15-ft cone of flame: DEX save, 3d6 fire or half on a success. +1d6 per slot.

name: Charm Person
summary: A humanoid within 30 ft makes a WIS save (advantage if you are fighting it) or is charmed by you for 1 hour; +1 target per slot.

name: Chromatic Orb
summary: Ranged spell attack with an orb of acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder for 3d8 of that type. +1d8 per slot.

name: Color Spray
summary: A 15-ft cone blinds creatures starting with the lowest HP, up to a 6d10 HP pool, until your next turn. +2d10 pool per slot.

name: Command
summary: Speak a one-word command; a creature within 60 ft makes a WIS save or obeys on its next turn (approach, drop, flee, grovel, halt). +1 target per slot.

name: Comprehend Languages
summary: For 1 hour you understand any spoken language you hear and any written language you touch.

name: Compelled Duel
summary: A creature within 30 ft makes a WIS save or has disadvantage attacking anyone but you and can't willingly move more than 30 ft from you.

name: Create or Destroy Water
summary: Create or destroy up to 10 gallons of water within 30 ft, or clear fog in a 30-ft cube; +10 gallons per slot.

name: Cure Wounds
summary: A touched creature regains 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP. +1d8 per slot.

name: Detect Evil and Good
summary: For 10 minutes sense aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead within 30 ft, plus consecrated or desecrated places.

name: Detect Magic
summary: For 10 minutes sense magic within 30 ft and see its aura and school.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
summary: For 10 minutes sense poisons, poisonous creatures and diseases within 30 ft.

name: Disguise Self
summary: Change your appearance, clothing and gear for 1 hour; Investigation against your spell DC sees through it.

name: Dissonant Whispers
summary: A creature within 60 ft makes a WIS save or takes 3d6 psychic and must use its reaction to flee; half on success. +1d6 per slot.

name: Divine Favor
summary: For 1 minute your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant on a hit.

name: Ensnaring Strike
summary: Your next weapon hit makes the target STR save or be restrained by thorns, taking 1d6 piercing each turn; repeat STR check to escape. +1d6 per slot.

name: Entangle
summary: Grasping plants fill a 20-ft square within 90 ft as difficult terrain; creatures there make a STR save or are restrained for 1 minute.

name: Expeditious Retreat
summary: For 10 minutes you can take the Dash action as a bonus action each turn.

name: Faerie Fire
summary: Objects and creatures in a 20-ft cube within 60 ft make a DEX save or glow; attacks against them have advantage and they can't be invisible.

name: False Life
summary: Gain 1d4 + 4 temporary HP for 1 hour; +5 per slot.

name: Feather Fall
summary: Up to five falling creatures within 60 ft descend slowly (60 ft per round) and take no falling damage.

name: Find Familiar
summary: Summon a spirit familiar in a small animal form that can scout, share senses and deliver your touch spells.

name: Fog Cloud
summary: A 20-ft radius sphere of fog within 120 ft heavily obscures the area for up to 1 hour; radius +20 ft per slot.

name: Goodberry
summary: Create ten berries that last 24 hours; eating one restores 1 HP and a day's nourishment.

repeat.label: Feed a Goodberry
repeat.desc: A creature eats a berry and regains 1 HP.

name: Grease
summary: Slick grease covers a 10-ft square within 60 ft for 1 minute: difficult terrain, and creatures there or entering make a DEX save or fall prone.

name: Guiding Bolt
summary: Ranged spell attack for 4d6 radiant; the next attack against the target before your next turn has advantage. +1d6 per slot.

name: Hail of Thorns
summary: Your next ranged weapon hit bursts into thorns: the target and creatures within 5 ft make a DEX save or take 1d10 piercing, half on success. +1d10 per slot.

name: Healing Word
summary: A creature you can see within 60 ft regains 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP. +1d4 per slot.

name: Hellish Rebuke
summary: When a creature damages you, it makes a DEX save or takes 2d10 fire, half on success. +1d10 per slot.

name: Heroism
summary: A touched creature is immune to fear and gains temp HP equal to your spellcasting modifier each turn for 1 minute; +1 target per slot.

name: Hex
summary: Curse a creature within 90 ft: your hits deal it an extra 1d6 necrotic and it has disadvantage on checks with one ability. Lasts longer with higher slots.

name: Hunter's Mark
summary: Mark a creature within 90 ft: your weapon hits deal it an extra 1d6 and you have advantage tracking it. Lasts longer with higher slots.

name: Identify
summary: Learn a touched magic item's properties and how to use it, or the spells affecting a creature or object.

name: Illusory Script
summary: Write a message on parchment that only chosen readers can understand for up to 10 days; others see gibberish or a decoy.

name: Inflict Wounds
summary: Melee spell attack for 3d10 necrotic. +1d10 per slot.

name: Jump
summary: A touched creature's jump distance triples for 1 minute.

name: Longstrider
summary: A touched creature's speed increases by 10 ft for 1 hour; +1 target per slot.

name: Mage Armor
summary: A touched unarmoured willing creature's AC becomes 13 + its DEX modifier for 8 hours.

name: Magic Missile
summary: Three darts automatically hit creatures within 120 ft for 1d4 + 1 force each. +1 dart per slot.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
summary: For 10 minutes aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead have disadvantage attacking a touched creature, which can't be charmed, frightened or possessed by them.

name: Purify Food and Drink
summary: Make all nonmagical food and drink in a 5-ft sphere within 10 ft free of poison and disease.

name: Ray of Sickness
summary: Ranged spell attack for 2d8 poison; the target must also make a CON save or be poisoned until your next turn. +1d8 per slot.

name: Sanctuary
summary: For 1 minute anyone targeting the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell must first pass a WIS save or pick another target; ends if it attacks.

name: Searing Smite
summary: Your next melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d6 fire and sets the target ablaze (1d6 fire each turn until a CON save). +1d6 per slot.

name: Shield
summary: When hit or targeted by magic missile, gain +5 AC until your next turn and take no damage from magic missile.

name: Shield of Faith
summary: A creature within 60 ft gains +2 AC for up to 10 minutes.

name: Silent Image
summary: Create a soundless visual illusion up to a 15-ft cube within 60 ft that you can move; Investigation reveals it.

name: Sleep
summary: Creatures in a 20-ft sphere within 90 ft fall asleep starting with the lowest HP, up to a 5d8 HP pool. +2d8 pool per slot.

name: Speak with Animals
summary: For 10 minutes you can understand and verbally communicate with beasts.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
summary: A creature within 30 ft makes a WIS save or falls prone, laughing and incapacitated; it repeats the save each turn and when damaged.

name: Tenser's Floating Disk
summary: A 3-ft floating disk that carries up to 500 lb follows you for 1 hour.

name: Thunderous Smite
summary: Your next melee weapon hit deals an extra 2d6 thunder and the target makes a STR save or is pushed 10 ft and knocked prone.

name: Thunderwave
summary: A 15-ft cube of thunder from you: CON save or 2d8 thunder and pushed 10 ft; half and no push on success. +1d8 per slot.

name: Unseen Servant
summary: An invisible mindless force performs simple chores for you for 1 hour.

name: Witch Bolt
summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d12 lightning; on later turns you can use your action to deal 1d12 automatically while it stays in range. +1d12 per slot.

name: Wrathful Smite
summary: Your next melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d6 psychic and the target makes a WIS save or is frightened of you.

name: Beast Bond
summary: Form a telepathic link with a friendly beast; it has advantage on attacks against creatures you can see within 5 ft of it.

name: Catapult
summary: Fling a 1-5 lb object up to 90 ft; a creature in its path makes a DEX save or takes 3d8 bludgeoning. +1d8 per slot.

name: Cause Fear
summary: A creature within 60 ft makes a WIS save or is frightened of you, repeating the save each turn; +1 target per slot. Constructs and undead immune.

name: Ceremony
summary: Perform a religious rite such as atonement, blessing water, coming of age, dedication, funeral, wedding or investiture.

name: Chaos Bolt
summary: Ranged spell attack for 2d8 + 1d6 of a random type; doubles on the d8s let it leap to another target. +1d6 per slot.

name: Earth Tremor
summary: Creatures within 10 ft make a DEX save or take 1d6 bludgeoning and fall prone; loose ground becomes difficult terrain. +1d6 per slot.

name: Ice Knife
summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 piercing; the shard then bursts and everything within 5 ft makes a DEX save or takes 2d6 cold. +1d6 cold per slot.

name: Snare
summary: Set a hidden magical trap in a 5-ft circle for 8 hours; a creature that enters makes a DEX save or is hoisted and restrained.

name: Zephyr Strike
summary: Your movement provokes no opportunity attacks for 1 minute; once, gain advantage on a weapon attack that deals an extra 1d8 force and +30 ft speed.

name: Tasha's Caustic Brew
summary: A 30-ft line of acid: DEX save or covered, taking 2d4 acid at the start of each turn until scraped off. +2d4 per slot.

name: Gift of Alacrity
summary: A touched willing creature adds 1d8 to its initiative rolls for 8 hours.

name: Magnify Gravity
summary: Gravity surges in a 10-ft sphere within 60 ft: CON save or 2d8 force and speed halved; half damage on success. +1d8 per slot.

name: Distort Value
summary: Make a touched object look worth double or half its true value for 8 hours.

name: Jim's Magic Missile
summary: Three darts each make a ranged spell attack for 2d4 force (a miss still deals 1); +1 dart per slot.

name: Silvery Barbs
summary: When a creature within 60 ft succeeds on an attack, check or save, force a reroll keeping the lower, then grant a creature advantage on its next roll.

name: Aid
summary: Up to three creatures within 30 ft raise their HP maximum and current HP by 5 for 8 hours; +5 per slot.

name: Alter Self
summary: For 1 hour change your form: breathe water and swim, alter your appearance, or grow magical natural weapons dealing 1d6.

name: Animal Messenger
summary: A Tiny beast carries a 25-word message to a place and recipient you describe over 24 hours.

name: Arcane Lock
summary: Magically lock a door, window or container until dispelled; chosen creatures can open it, and forcing it gets +10 DC.

name: Augury
summary: Receive an omen (weal, woe, both or nothing) about a course of action within the next 30 minutes.

name: Barkskin
summary: A touched creature's AC can't be lower than 16 for up to 1 hour.

name: Blindness/Deafness
summary: A creature within 30 ft makes a CON save or is blinded or deafened for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn; +1 target per slot.

name: Blur
summary: Your body blurs: attacks against you have disadvantage for 1 minute unless the attacker doesn't rely on sight.

name: Branding Smite
summary: Your next weapon hit deals an extra 2d6 radiant and the target sheds light and can't be invisible for 1 minute. +1d6 per slot.

name: Calm Emotions
summary: Humanoids in a 20-ft sphere within 60 ft make a CHA save or have charm and fear suppressed or hostility toward chosen creatures removed.

name: Cloud of Daggers
summary: Spinning daggers fill a 5-ft cube within 60 ft; a creature entering it or starting its turn there takes 4d4 slashing. +2d4 per slot.

name: Continual Flame
summary: A heatless torch-bright flame burns on a touched object until dispelled.

name: Cordon of Arrows
summary: Enchant four pieces of ammunition planted in the ground; for 8 hours each fires at a creature entering within 30 ft (DEX save or 1d6 piercing). +2 pieces per slot.

name: Crown of Madness
summary: A humanoid within 120 ft makes a WIS save or is charmed and must attack a creature you choose; repeats the save each turn.

name: Darkness
summary: Magical darkness fills a 15-ft radius sphere within 60 ft for 10 minutes; darkvision can't see through it.

name: Darkvision
summary: A touched willing creature gains 60-ft darkvision for 8 hours.

name: Detect Thoughts
summary: Read the surface thoughts of creatures within 30 ft, and probe deeper with a WIS save contest.

name: Enhance Ability
summary: A touched creature gets advantage on checks with one ability for 1 hour (Bear's Endurance also grants 2d6 temp HP); +1 target per slot.

name: Enlarge/Reduce
summary: A creature or object within 30 ft grows (+1d4 weapon damage, advantage on STR) or shrinks (-1d4, disadvantage) for 1 minute; unwilling targets get a CON save.

name: Enthrall
summary: Creatures within 60 ft that can hear you make a WIS save or have disadvantage on Perception checks to notice anyone else for 1 minute.

name: Find Steed
summary: Summon a loyal spirit steed (warhorse, pony, camel, elk or mastiff) that shares your telepathic bond.

name: Find Traps
summary: Sense the presence, but not the location, of any trap within 120 ft that you have line of sight to.

name: Flame Blade
summary: Conjure a fiery blade for 10 minutes; melee spell attack for 3d6 fire. +1d6 per two slot levels.

repeat.label: Flame Blade: slash
repeat.desc: Melee spell attack with the blade, 3d6 fire.

name: Flaming Sphere
summary: A 5-ft sphere of fire within 60 ft; creatures ending a turn next to it or rammed by it make a DEX save, 2d6 fire or half. +1d6 per slot.

repeat.label: Move Flaming Sphere
repeat.desc: Move the sphere up to 30 ft; ram a creature to burn it.

name: Gentle Repose
summary: Protect a touched corpse from decay and undeath for 10 days; that time doesn't count against raising it.

name: Gust of Wind
summary: A 60-ft line of strong wind: creatures starting there make a STR save or are pushed 15 ft; moving into it costs double.

name: Heat Metal
summary: Heat a metal object within 60 ft: anyone touching it takes 2d8 fire (repeat as a bonus action) and has disadvantage if it keeps holding it. +1d8 per slot.

name: Hold Person
summary: A humanoid within 60 ft makes a WIS save or is paralyzed, repeating the save each turn; +1 target per slot.

name: Invisibility
summary: A touched creature becomes invisible for up to 1 hour or until it attacks or casts a spell; +1 target per slot.

name: Knock
summary: Unlock a stuck, barred or locked object within 60 ft with a loud knock; suppresses Arcane Lock for 10 minutes.

name: Lesser Restoration
summary: End one disease or the blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned condition on a touched creature.

name: Levitate
summary: A creature or object within 60 ft rises up to 20 ft and hangs there for up to 10 minutes; unwilling creatures get a CON save.

name: Locate Animals or Plants
summary: Learn the direction and distance to the nearest named kind of beast or plant within 5 miles.

name: Locate Object
summary: Sense the direction of a familiar or described object within 1,000 ft for 10 minutes; blocked by lead.

name: Magic Mouth
summary: Implant a message of up to 25 words in an object that plays when a trigger you set occurs.

name: Magic Weapon
summary: A touched nonmagical weapon becomes a +1 magic weapon for 1 hour (+2 with a 4th-level slot, +3 with 6th).

name: Melf's Acid Arrow
summary: Ranged spell attack for 4d4 acid plus 2d4 more at the end of its next turn; a miss deals half the initial damage. +1d4 per slot to each part.

name: Mirror Image
summary: Three illusory duplicates appear for 1 minute; attacks against you may hit a duplicate (AC 10 + DEX) instead, destroying it.

name: Misty Step
summary: Teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Moonbeam
summary: A 5-ft radius beam of moonlight within 120 ft: creatures entering or starting there make a CON save, 2d10 radiant or half. Move it 60 ft as an action. +1d10 per slot.

name: Nystul's Magic Aura
summary: For 24 hours make a touched object or creature read falsely to divination magic.

name: Pass without Trace
summary: For 1 hour you and allies within 30 ft gain +10 to Stealth checks and leave no tracks.

name: Phantasmal Force
summary: A creature within 60 ft makes an INT save or perceives an illusion you craft; it can take 1d6 psychic each turn from the phantasm.

name: Prayer of Healing
summary: Up to six creatures within 30 ft each regain 2d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP. +1d8 per slot.

name: Protection from Poison
summary: Neutralise one poison on a touched creature; for 1 hour it has advantage on saves against poison and resists poison damage.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
summary: Ranged spell attack; on a hit the target deals only half damage with STR-based weapon attacks for 1 minute (CON save at end of each turn).

name: Rope Trick
summary: A rope rises from your space to an invisible extradimensional space that stays open for 1 hour. Allies within 5 ft climb in (Climb Rope: 10 ft of movement) and drop back out freely; it holds eight Medium or smaller creatures. Attacks and spells can't cross the entrance.

name: Scorching Ray
summary: Three rays each make a ranged spell attack for 2d6 fire. +1 ray per slot.

name: See Invisibility
summary: For 1 hour you see invisible creatures and objects and into the Ethereal Plane.

name: Shatter
summary: A 10-ft radius burst of sound within 60 ft: CON save, 3d8 thunder or half (inorganic creatures have disadvantage). +1d8 per slot.

name: Silence
summary: No sound can exist in a 20-ft sphere within 120 ft for 10 minutes; those inside are deafened, immune to thunder and can't cast verbal spells.

name: Spider Climb
summary: A touched creature can climb walls and ceilings hands-free and gains a climb speed equal to its speed for 1 hour.

name: Spike Growth
summary: Hidden thorns cover a 20-ft radius within 150 ft: difficult terrain, and creatures take 2d4 piercing for every 5 ft they move through it.

name: Spiritual Weapon
summary: A floating spectral weapon within 60 ft makes a melee spell attack for 1d8 + your modifier force; move it and attack again as a bonus action. +1d8 per two slot levels.

name: Suggestion
summary: A creature within 30 ft makes a WIS save or follows a reasonable-sounding course of action you suggest for up to 8 hours.

name: Warding Bond
summary: A touched creature gets +1 AC and saves and resists all damage for 1 hour, but you take the same damage it does.

name: Web
summary: Sticky webs fill a 20-ft cube within 60 ft: difficult terrain, and creatures entering or starting there make a DEX save or are restrained.

name: Zone of Truth
summary: Creatures in a 15-ft sphere within 60 ft make a CHA save or can't deliberately lie for 10 minutes.

name: Aganazzar's Scorcher
summary: A 30-ft line of roaring flame: DEX save, 3d8 fire or half. +1d8 per slot.

name: Dragon's Breath
summary: A touched creature can use its action to exhale a 15-ft cone of acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison: DEX save, 3d6 or half. +1d6 per slot.

name: Dust Devil
summary: A 5-ft whirlwind within 60 ft; creatures ending a turn next to it make a STR save or take 1d8 bludgeoning and are pushed 10 ft, half on success. +1d8 per slot.

repeat.label: Move Dust Devil
repeat.desc: Move the dust devil up to 30 ft.

name: Earthbind
summary: A creature within 300 ft makes a STR save or its flying speed drops to 0 and it descends 60 ft per round for 1 minute.

name: Healing Spirit
summary: A spirit fills a 5-ft cube within 60 ft; a creature entering or starting its turn there can regain 1d6 HP (limited uses). +1d6 per slot.

repeat.label: Move Healing Spirit
repeat.desc: Move the spirit up to 30 ft.

name: Maximilian's Earthen Grasp
summary: An earthen hand rises within 30 ft; a creature within 5 ft of it makes a STR save or takes 2d6 bludgeoning and is restrained.

name: Mind Spike
summary: A creature within 60 ft makes a WIS save or takes 3d8 psychic (half on success) and you always know its location for 1 hour. +1d8 per slot.

name: Pyrotechnics
summary: Turn a fire within 60 ft into fireworks (CON save or blinded until your next turn for creatures within 10 ft) or a 20-ft cloud of thick smoke.

name: Shadow Blade
summary: Conjure a shadow sword (finesse, light, thrown 20/60) dealing 2d8 psychic for 1 minute; advantage in dim light. Extra 1d8 at slots 3, 5 and 7.

repeat.label: Shadow Blade: strike
repeat.desc: Weapon attack with the shadow sword (finesse), 2d8 psychic.

name: Skywrite
summary: Write up to ten words in the sky with clouds for up to 1 hour.

name: Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
summary: Snowballs burst in a 5-ft radius within 90 ft: DEX save, 3d6 cold or half. +1d6 per slot.

name: Warding Wind
summary: A 10-ft wind around you deafens creatures inside, disperses gas, makes the area difficult terrain for others and gives ranged attacks through it disadvantage.

name: Summon Beast
summary: Summon a bestial spirit (air, land or water) that fights for you for 1 hour; its stats scale with slot level.

name: Tasha's Mind Whip
summary: A creature within 90 ft makes an INT save or takes 3d6 psychic, can't react and gets only a move, action or bonus action next turn; half on success. +1 target per slot.

name: Fortune's Favor
summary: A creature within 60 ft can roll a d20 once in the next hour and use it in place of one attack, check or save roll; +1 target per slot.

name: Immovable Object
summary: Fix a touched object of 10 lb or less in place for 1 hour; it holds up to 4,000 lb and can be set to move for chosen creatures.

name: Wristpocket
summary: Flick a held object of 5 lb or less into an extradimensional pocket and recall it at will for 1 hour.

name: Nathair's Mischief
summary: A 20-ft cube of fey magic within 60 ft rolls a random effect each turn: charmed, blinded, sneezing incapacitation, or difficult terrain (WIS save resists).

name: Rime's Binding Ice
summary: A 30-ft cone of frost: CON save or 3d8 cold and speed 0 for 1 minute (ice can be chipped free); half damage only on success. +1d8 per slot.

name: Gift of Gab
summary: Edit a creature's memory of the last 6 seconds of your speech so it recalls whatever words you choose.

name: Jim's Glowing Coin
summary: Throw an enchanted coin within 60 ft; creatures that see it make a WIS save or are distracted, with disadvantage on Perception and initiative for 1 minute.

name: Borrowed Knowledge
summary: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice for 1 hour.

name: Kinetic Jaunt
summary: For 1 minute your speed rises by 10 ft, you provoke no opportunity attacks and can move through other creatures' spaces.

name: Vortex Warp
summary: A creature within 90 ft makes a CON save or is teleported to a spot within range you can see (willing creatures may fail). Range +30 ft per slot.

name: Wither and Bloom
summary: Chosen creatures in a 10-ft sphere within 60 ft make a CON save, 2d6 necrotic or half; one creature inside can spend a Hit Die to heal. +1d6 per slot.
